reviewer: showcase-gemini (bead ksi — add interactive socket pool simulator and telemetry)

spec_match.rationale: Interactive simulator directly demonstrates dynamic TCP socket pool limit randomization (5-8 connections drawn per partition at load/reset) and top-level security context (NAK) partitioning, contrasting with legacy global pooling.

interactive.rationale: Full user-driven controls: pooling architecture select, security context partition select, request burst slider, fire burst button, adversary probe simulation, and reset button with real-time socket slot state rendering.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Feature-index blurb and page H1/lede share the same framing and surface the same API affordances.

edge_cases.rationale: Demonstrates head-of-line blocking request queueing when burst exceeds the partition limit, and explains passive fingerprinting mitigation across cross-site contexts.

references.rationale: see-also section links to ChromeStatus entry, MDN HTTP/1.x connection management, and sibling pool demos.

design_system.rationale: Uses CSS variables, 2px borders, high-contrast WCAG AAA slot indicators (#064e3b on #ffffff = 9.72:1; #2d2d2d on #f4f3ee = 12.4:1; #784200 on #fef7e6 = 7.63:1), 44px min-height tap targets, and wrapped compare table.

accessibility.rationale: All interactive inputs and buttons are keyboard-accessible with visible focus outlines, labelled controls, and live telemetry announced via aria-live polite region.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified in Chrome DevTools MCP at mobile 360x740 DPR3 (0px overflow) and desktop 1280x800.

summary: security-context updated (bead ksi): converted from static explanation card into an interactive socket pool partition simulator with user-driven request bursts, live slot allocation indicators, real-time telemetry, 44px tap targets, and verified 0px mobile overflow at 360px viewport.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible interactive simulator controls 44px tap targets aria-live
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Provide labelled controls with minimum 44px tap targets and aria-live polite updates for interactive simulation telemetry.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied. All buttons and form inputs meet 44px height; telemetry output uses role=status aria-live=polite.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: DevTools MCP evaluation confirmed dynamic 5-8 limits at load/reset, 0px overflow, and clean interactive execution on mobile 360x740.
